description: This file defines the 'Obs' class in Java, which models a clinical observation within the OpenMRS healthcare system. It includes properties and methods for handling various types of observation data, grouping, versioning, and interpretation, reflecting the structure and behavior of an observation entity in medical records.

classes.name: Obs
classes.description: Represents a clinical observation in the OpenMRS system, supporting hierarchical grouping, versioning, and various data types. Facilitates the recording, retrieval, and interpretation of medical observations.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new copy of an existing Obs instance, copying property values and handling group members appropriately.

methods.name: getValueAsBoolean
methods.description: Coerces the observation's value to a Boolean, based on coded or numeric values.

methods.name: setValueAsString
methods.description: Parses a string and sets the observation's value based on the concept's data type.

methods.name: getValueAsString
methods.description: Returns the observation's value formatted as a string, respecting locale and data type.
